title: Year 4 Psychiatry — Junior Clerkship
summary: Mount Kenya University, Department of Psychiatry & Mental Health. Three semesters of weekly lectures with a clinical rotation each week.
team: Dr. Kendi (HOD & Senior Lecturer), Dr. Neema Araka (Lecturer), Dr. Nganga & Dr. Arthur (rotation supervisors). Clinical rotations: Thika Level 5 Hospital and Mathari National Hospital.
assessment: CATs 30% · Logbook & presentations 10% · End-of-clerkship examination 60% (MCQ/SAQ + OSCE/viva).

sections.title: Semester 1 — Foundations of Assessment & Major Disorders
sections.note: Dr. Kendi: history taking, psychopathology, psychotic / neurodevelopmental / neurodegenerative disorders, emergencies. Dr. Neema: classification, MSE, mood / anxiety / somatic disorders, suicide, substance use. Ends with a written CAT + OSCE (history-taking & MSE).

items.title: Adult psychiatric history taking
items.detail: Structured adult history: presenting complaint, HPC, past psychiatric/medical, family and social history; building rapport.

items.detail: Developmental history, parental/collateral reports, age-appropriate rapport.

items.title: Mental State Examination (MSE)
items.detail: Appearance, behaviour, speech, mood/affect, thought, perception, cognition, insight — and documenting them.

team: Dr. Rosslyn Ngugi and Dr. Alex Wagucu (Lecturers), Dr. Nahashon Okanga (HOD).

title: Clinical Pharmacology — MBChB Level IV
summary: Mount Kenya University, Dr. K. Ndemo. Three trimester units (MBPL 4411, 4422, 4433). Week numbers follow the order in each outline PDF; open the PDF for the full sub-topic detail.
assessment: One CAT at the end of each trimester, plus end-of-year exams.

sections.title: Trimester 1 · Cardiovascular & blood drugs (MBPL 4411)
sections.note: For each class: mechanism & site of action, pharmacological properties, side effects, clinical uses.

items.title: Antihypertensive agents I
items.detail: Overview of hypertension; beta-blockers, alpha-blockers, centrally acting agents, sympathetic nerve terminal blockers.

items.title: Antihypertensive agents III
items.detail: Vasodilators, calcium channel blockers, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, renin inhibitors.

items.title: Drugs used in heart failure
items.detail: ACE inhibitors, ARBs, aldosterone antagonists, beta-blockers, diuretics, vasodilators, inotropes (digoxin, beta-agonists, PDE inhibitors).

items.title: Drugs used in cardiac arrhythmias
items.detail: Cardiac electrophysiology, mechanisms of arrhythmia, Class I–IV drugs.

items.title: Drugs used in angina pectoris
items.detail: Organic nitrates, calcium channel blockers, beta-blockers, sodium channel blockers.

items.title: Acute coronary syndromes I
items.detail: Fibrinolytics (activators and inhibitors) and antiplatelet drugs (COX-1, P2Y12, GP IIb/IIIa, dipyridamole, cilostazol).

items.title: Acute coronary syndromes II — indirect thrombin inhibitors
items.detail: Unfractionated heparin; LMWH (enoxaparin, dalteparin, tinzaparin).

items.title: Acute coronary syndromes III
items.detail: Hirudin, bivalirudin; fondaparinux (parenteral factor Xa inhibitor).

items.title: Oral anticoagulants
items.detail: Warfarin / coumarins; dabigatran; rivaroxaban, apixaban, edoxaban.

items.title: Drugs used in hyperlipoproteinaemias
items.detail: Lipoprotein transport; statins, niacin, fibrates, bile-acid resins, cholesterol absorption inhibitors, omega-3.
